capabilities: Create a formatted note from the article with parsed headers
Filter unsuitable articles by minimum headers, retries, and disallowed headers
Configure the save location for generated notes
extras: The README describes a dice ribbon icon in the top left as the main trigger; no usage examples or screenshots are given.
motivation: The author built it to encourage daily note-taking and learning.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull random reference material into the vault to spark daily note-taking and learning.
summary: Wikipedia note generator that fetches a random article and creates a formatted note in the vault.
